name: minimax-bot
description: Turn MiniMax Code into an always-on team of Bots. A Chief Bot helps you build the team; in group chats the admin answers and @mentions hand work to other members. Every Bot has its own octopus avatar and memory, with scheduled tasks and usage stats.
author: MiniMax Code
exampleQueries: Open MiniMax Bot and have Chief set up a small writing team
